nodes.label: Spec 0001. POOL initial architecture
First build decision (two packages, three dependencies, fixed finding vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Adds detail to the ratified foundation and changes none of it; output is built only from constants, key names, line and column so file content never reaches it.

nodes.label: Modular daemon with independent CLI decision
nodes.rationale: Chosen for the four VM scenario, small operational surface and vertical delivery; the separate controller executable is deferred until multiple proxies need a single authority.

nodes.label: External etcd for future coordination
nodes.rationale: Reuse established consensus; an embedded consensus library creates a larger storage and operations obligation.

nodes.label: Per lease virtual cancellation credentials
nodes.rationale: Real backend keys stay private and a backend is retired after any forwarded cancellation so uncertain delivery cannot reach a later lease; the promise is isolation across leases.

nodes.label: Workspace layout and manifests
Data plane and control plane separation
nodes.rationale: The data plane reads immutable topology snapshots and never does blocking journal work, infrastructure calls or consensus per query; control publishes snapshots only after validation.
